summary: Structural grant editor (E3.4): a write-API for grants and role-assignments (POST /api/grants, POST /api/grants/:id/revoke, POST /api/role-assignments, POST /api/role-assignments/:id/revoke) where every write is gated by the T-0029 validateAdminDelegation checker (isGenesisOwner resolved from DB, never assumed), scope is composed from closed lattice dictionaries (registry/op/scope — no free text), every create/revoke emits a GrantAuditEvent into the audit floor, and the existing ra-role-editor.jsx progressive-disclosure UI (simple presets + advanced grant atoms + LLM-proposes panel) is wired to the write-API. Day-1 = API + UI wire-up; DB read-path (GET /api/rights) may remain seed-backed until T-0053.
functional: FR-1 POST /api/grants accepts a structural body (role_id, resource_type, operation, ScopeElement scope, optional resource_facet/constraint/delegable/valid_from/valid_until/proposed_by/confirmed_by) and inserts a grant row; free-text scope is rejected (INVALID_SCOPE 400); freeform scope accepted only if isGenesisOwner.

FR-2 Every grant write gated by validateAdminDelegation: admin context (isGenesisOwner, adminGrants, adminOrgScope) is resolved from the DB before INSERT; rejection → 403 ADMIN_GATE_REJECTED with typed reason.
FR-3 POST /api/grants/:id/revoke soft-revokes (sets valid_until=now_ms, does not delete); gated by validateAdminDelegation; emits GrantAuditEvent kind=grant.revoke.

FR-4 POST /api/role-assignments creates a role_assignment row (employee_id, role_id, org-hierarchy ScopeElement org_scope, validity window, source, granted_by, optional proposed_by/confirmed_by); gated by validateAdminDelegation kind=assignment (org-axis).
FR-5 POST /api/role-assignments/:id/revoke soft-revokes (valid_until=now_ms); gated by validateAdminDelegation.
FR-6 Every successful create and revoke emits GrantAuditEvent (kind grant.create or grant.revoke) into audit_event table; proposed_by/confirmed_by threaded from request body.

FR-7 ra-role-editor.jsx RoleEditorScreen wired: submit button calls POST /api/grants per grant; LLM-proposes panel sets proposed_by=llm, confirmed_by=null on proposals; confirmation call sets confirmed_by; simple (preset) mode expands presets into structural atoms before POST.

FR-8 GET /api/rights/dictionaries returns resources (uri+name), operations (array of operation literals), orgTree (id/label/depth/children), scopeTags (id/label) — closed dictionaries the UI picker is built from.
non_functional: NF-1 Scope must parse as a structural ScopeElement (node/tags/interval/set); no free-text rights descriptions; parseScope reuses normalize from grant-lattice.ts.
NF-2 All INSERTs and UPDATEs carry tenant_id from the authenticated request context; RLS policies on grant and role_assignment are not bypassed.
NF-3 isGenesisOwner is DB-resolved (role_assignment JOIN role WHERE slug=tenant-owner AND confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND validity window); never hardcoded or assumed from JWT claims.
NF-4 No new scope algebra: scope validation reuses grant-lattice.ts isNarrowerOrEqual/normalize; no new ScopeElement kind introduced.

NF-5 No new DDL tables day-1 (writes land in existing grant and role_assignment tables); if a new table is added it must be numbered 030+, have tenant_id leading, RLS, FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY, GRANT to choros_app, and appear in known_tenant_tables.txt.
NF-6 GrantAuditEvent shape imported verbatim from grant-lattice.ts; not redefined.
NF-7 validateAdminDelegation imported from src/core/scoped-admin.ts verbatim; not reimplemented in the write-API module.

NF-8 HTTP error codes machine-readable: validateAdminDelegation rejection → 403 {code:ADMIN_GATE_REJECTED, reason:<typed>}; malformed scope → 400 INVALID_SCOPE; unknown role_id/employee_id → 404; tenant mismatch → 403 CROSS_TENANT.
out_of_scope: LLM-proposes-grants BYO-LLM call = T-0039 (E3.5); T-0030 only wires proposed_by/confirmed_by fields and UI panel.
DB-backed grant read resolution = T-0053; GET /api/rights may remain seed-backed.
role_criticality computation = T-0040 (E4.5); UI criticality hint is display-only.
Dual-control two-approver gate = T-0044 (E4.6); proposed_by/confirmed_by schema is laid down here, enforcement is T-0044.
SoD enforcement on grant writes = T-0032; grant writes emit GrantAuditEvent (not actor_event).
Batch import / CSV-upload of grant sets.
Keycloak JWT auth = T-0054; dev: X-Dev-User header.

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /api/grants with a valid structural body (role_id, resource_type, operation, valid ScopeElement scope, granted_by) → 201 and a grant row inserted in grant table with correct tenant_id and supplied fields.
POST /api/grants where validateAdminDelegation returns {ok:false, reason:scope_widens} → 403 with code ADMIN_GATE_REJECTED and reason scope_widens; no row inserted.
POST /api/grants where validateAdminDelegation returns {ok:false, reason:org_scope_widens} → 403 with reason org_scope_widens; no row inserted.
POST /api/grants where validateAdminDelegation returns {ok:false, reason:no_admin_authority} → 403; no row inserted.
POST /api/grants with a free-text scope payload (not a parseable ScopeElement) → 400 INVALID_SCOPE; no row inserted.

POST /api/grants by the genesis owner (isGenesisOwner=true resolved from DB) with any valid structural scope → 201; no parent-subset check applied (validateAdminDelegation step-3 owner short-circuit).
POST /api/grants/:id/revoke by an authorized admin → 200; valid_until on the target grant row is set to the request time (epoch-ms); the row is NOT deleted.
POST /api/grants/:id/revoke by a principal without covering mgmt_object:grant authority → 403 ADMIN_GATE_REJECTED.
POST /api/role-assignments with valid body (employee_id, role_id, org-hierarchy ScopeElement org_scope, granted_by) → 201 and a row inserted in role_assignment with correct tenant_id.
POST /api/role-assignments where the target org_scope escapes the admin's adminOrgScope (org_scope_widens) → 403 ADMIN_GATE_REJECTED; no row inserted.
POST /api/role-assignments/:id/revoke by authorized admin → 200; valid_until set; row not deleted.

Every successful POST /api/grants emits a GrantAuditEvent (kind: grant.create) into the audit_event table with correct actor, subjectRoleId, capability (resourceType, operation), scope, and (when present) proposedBy/confirmedBy. Static lint asserts the emit call-site imports GrantAuditEvent from grant-lattice.ts.
Every successful POST /api/grants/:id/revoke emits a GrantAuditEvent (kind: grant.revoke) into audit_event.

POST /api/grants with proposed_by set and confirmed_by absent → row inserted with confirmed_by IS NULL (PROPOSAL, not effective). Subsequent confirmation updates confirmed_by to the confirming actor id.

isGenesisOwner is resolved from the DB (role_assignment JOIN role WHERE slug=tenant-owner AND confirmed_by IS NOT NULL AND validity window passes at request time); never assumed or hardcoded. Static lint asserts no hardcoded isGenesisOwner=true outside the DB-query helper.

GET /api/rights/dictionaries returns a JSON body containing resources (array with uri and name), operations (array of operation literals), orgTree (array of org nodes with id/label/depth/children), and scopeTags (array with id/label).

Progressive-disclosure UI: the submit button in RoleEditorScreen triggers POST /api/grants for each grant in the current set; a 403 response surfaces the typed rejection reason inline; a 201 response adds the grant to the confirmed-grants view.
Simple (preset) mode: selecting a preset and submitting expands it into structural grant atoms (same shape as advanced mode) before or at POST; no separate preset table is created.

No new tenant table is created by T-0030 (grant and role_assignment are the write targets; both already in known_tenant_tables.txt). If DESIGN adds a new table it must appear in known_tenant_tables.txt and have a seedRowForTable case in cross_tenant.test.ts.
Every DB write (INSERT INTO grant, UPDATE grant, INSERT INTO role_assignment, UPDATE role_assignment) includes tenant_id as the leading parameter; RLS policy not bypassed (no superuser path).
